name: MC-6 mini centrifuge
summary: A benchtop mini centrifuge with a four-position tube rack and two tubes: power switch, three push buttons, a speed dial, a hinged lid, two wells, a display and a light ring.
instruction: Run the MC-6 demo: these eight steps, in this order, and nothing else. 1. tube_pick on STOP (it finds the red tube in the rack with the camera and lifts it). 2. tube_place on STOP (it lowers the held tube into well A). 3. lid_close on STOP. 4. flip POWER with toward=1 (up, to ON). 5. press TIME+. 6. turn SPEED with angle=-60. 7. press START. 8. press STOP. Propose them as one plan, then report what each step did.
